newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Union body condemns spiral of violence in Algeria.
newsitem.headline: Union body condemns spiral of violence in Algeria.

text.p: The Brussels-based World Confederation of Labour (CMT) on Wednesday condemned the assassination of Algerian union leader Abdelhak Benhamouda and the spiral of violence in Algeria.
"CMT, disconcerted and outraged by the acts of violence which have affected Algeria for years, is horrified by the news of the assassination of Abdelhak Benhamouda," it said in a statement.
It noted it had already asked member organisations in 1993 to denounce "acts of blind violence" and was now reiterating its appeal.
CMT is known by the initials of its French title, the Confederation Mondiale du Travail.
